name: Prometheus Medical Emergency Medkit Belt Pouch
description:
A belt-mounted medical pouch containing a standardized emergency kit — coagulant patches, a single-use auto-injector loaded with broad-spectrum antitoxin, a flexible splint, and a biometric reader card. The pouch is sealed against environmental contamination and opens with a single pull-tab.

Required equipment for most licensed security firms and voluntarily carried by anyone who has seen what happens when a medical emergency occurs in a lower-tier district where the nearest clinic is forty minutes away.
functionality: Emergency medical response, antitoxin, wound treatment, basic diagnostics
what_it_says: You've accepted that someone near you is going to get hurt and you've decided to be useful when it happens.
story_hooks: A medkit pouch found at a scene has its auto-injector used but its coagulant patches untouched — someone needed the antitoxin but wasn't bleeding, suggesting poisoning rather than violence.

physical_description.visual_profile: A compact, utilitarian belt pouch positioned at the hip or lower torso. Angular, geometric shape with a reinforced rectangular footprint suggests serious cargo. Appears professional and ready-to-deploy, neither bulky nor concealed—the kind of gear you want visible.
physical_description.fit: Secured to standard belt loops or tactical webbing via injection-molded attachment points. Sits flush against the body when properly worn, minimal sway. Designed for quick access without fumbling.
physical_description.primary_material: Ballistic-grade synthetic composite with moisture-sealed seams. Inner polymer lining prevents reagent degradation and contamination ingress.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, non-porous exterior with subtle ribbed reinforcement along stress points. Pull-tab is slightly raised for tactile grip in emergency situations. Surface has a faint matte sheen from nanoscale protective coating.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal gray primary with high-visibility safety orange trim along edges and around the pull-tab. Subtle Prometheus Medical logomark (stylized caduceus) embossed in muted silver on front face.
physical_description.closures: Single color-coded pull-tab mechanism (orange) that breaks a tamper-evident seal. One-motion opening design for emergency deployment. Secondary retention via magnetic closure to prevent accidental opening during movement.
distinctive_features: Embossed biometric reader card slot on exterior face
Recessed pressure-release valve to equalize internal pressure
Wear-resistant corner guards in reinforced polymer
Regulatory compliance certification marks along bottom edge
Internal dividers visible through semi-transparent window panel
Expiration date window showing replacement interval
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 crossover—professional-grade equipment affordable to security contractors and safety-conscious working-class individuals. Signals medical preparedness and practical thinking rather than luxury.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by licensed security personnel, paramedics, first responders, gang medics, and trauma-savvy street survivors. Marks the wearer as either official infrastructure or street-smart enough to plan for the worst. A statement of competence and dark realism.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; shows light scuffing and minor stains after months of use. Older pouches display faded safety trim and worn corner guards from repeated deployment practice or actual use.
